shared_elements: large upright flat slab/pillar face carrying low relief
horizontal registers or bands of repeated motifs stacked one above another
narrow vertical relief figures on the flanking side faces/edges
low-relief animal-like forms in profile (legible in B, only faintly suggested in A)
justification: Both show a broad upright slab face divided into stacked horizontal registers of low relief, with additional narrow relief figures running down the flanking vertical edges, and both use shallow, flat, schematic carving rather than modelled naturalism. The decisive difference is that B's content is legible and specific — a row of crouching creatures along the top, a fringe-like band of vertical strokes, profile birds/reptiles, a quadruped and a handled bag-like object — whereas A presents only faint horizontal lines with no identifiable creatures or objects, so no distinctive motif or relationship can be matched between them.
